candidates.name: Toxoplasmosis
support_spans: Serum toxoplasma IgG was elevated
positive toxoplasma IgG and DNA-PCR for Toxoplasma gondii (286 copies/mL)
Histopathologic examination of the brain tissue revealed bradyzoites and tachyzoites
candidates.why: The patient has a ring-enhancing lesion in the brain with elevated toxoplasma IgG and DNA-PCR for Toxoplasma gondii, and histopathologic examination revealed bradyzoites and tachyzoites, which are all indicative of toxoplasmosis.

candidates.name: Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia
support_spans: He was found to have HIV infection with a CD4 count <20 cells/µL
diffuse reticulonodular interstitial prominence
extensive reticulonodular interstitial infiltrates with focal consolidation in the left upper lobe
candidates.why: The patient has a low CD4 count and presents with respiratory symptoms and radiographic findings consistent with Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia, a common opportunistic infection in HIV patients.

candidates.name: HIV-associated immune suppression
support_spans: He was found to have HIV infection with a CD4 count <20 cells/µL
an HIV viral load of 191 000 copies/mL
candidates.why: The patient has a low CD4 count and a high HIV viral load, indicating severe immune suppression, which increases the risk of opportunistic infections such as toxoplasmosis and Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia.
